text.p: Swedish defence group Celsius AB said on Monday that its results for 1996 were better than expected with preliminary figures showing a profit after financial items of 347 million crowns.
For calendar 1995 Celsius reported a loss after financial items of 421 million crowns.
Celsius said in a statement that 1996 sales were expected to be around 11 billion crowns against 14.8 billion crowns a year ago.
Celsius in its nine-month report had forecast a full year profit after financial items of about 275 million crowns.
"During the year's final months however net financial items have developed better than expected," Celsius's managing director Olle Lund said in a statement.
Celsius is due to release its 1996 earnings report on February 27.
